parameters.name: ResourceGroup
parameters.label: Resource Group
parameters.query:
resourceContainers 
| where type == "microsoft.resources/subscriptions/resourcegroups"
| join kind = inner (
    resourcecontainers
    | where type == "microsoft.resources/subscriptions"
    | project subscriptionId, subscriptionName = name
) on $left.subscriptionId == $right.subscriptionId
| project resourceGroup, name, subscriptionId, subscriptionName
| join kind = inner (
    resources
    | where type == "microsoft.hybridcompute/machines"
    | distinct resourceGroup, subscriptionId
) on resourceGroup, subscriptionId
| project value = resourceGroup, label = name, group = subscriptionName

content.query:
resources
| where type == "microsoft.hybridcompute/machines" and tostring(tags['sqlmanaged']) != 'false'
| extend joinID = toupper(id)
| project joinID
| join kind=inner (
    resources
    | where type == "microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances" and ('*' in ({ResourceGroup}) or resourceGroup in ({ResourceGroup}))
    | extend machineId = toupper(tostring(properties.containerResourceId))
    | project InstanceName = name, Edition = tostring(properties.edition), machineId
) on $left.joinID == $right.machineId
| summarize Instances = count() by Edition

| project joinID
| join kind=inner (
    resources
    | where type == "microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances" and ('*' in ({ResourceGroup}) or resourceGroup in ({ResourceGroup}))
    | extend machineId = toupper(tostring(properties.containerResourceId))
    | project InstanceId = id, InstanceName = name, Version = tostring(properties.version), machineId
) on $left.joinID == $right.machineId
| join kind = inner (
resources

) on InstanceId
| project InstanceName
| summarize count() by InstanceName

content.query:
resources
| where type == "microsoft.hybridcompute/machines" and tostring(tags['sqlmanaged']) != 'false'
| extend joinID = toupper(id)
| project joinID
| join kind=inner (
    resources
    | where type == "microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances" and ('*' in ({ResourceGroup}) or resourceGroup in ({ResourceGroup}))
    | extend machineId = toupper(tostring(properties.containerResourceId))
    | project ResourceId = toupper(id), InstanceName = name, properties = tostring(properties), tags, ResourceGroup = strcat('/subscriptions/', subscriptionId, '/resourceGroups/',resourceGroup), Subscription = strcat('/subscriptions/', subscriptionId), machineId
    | extend parsedProperties = parse_json(properties)
    ) on $left.joinID == $right.machineId
    | project
        ResourceId,
        InstanceName= tostring(parsedProperties.instanceName),
        Version = tostring(parsedProperties.version),
        Edition = tostring(parsedProperties.edition),
        BuildNumber = tostring(parsedProperties.patchLevel),
        vCores = tostring(parsedProperties.vCore),
        Collation = tostring(parsedProperties.collation),
        MainstreamSupportEndDate = case( substring(tostring(parsedProperties.patchLevel), 0, 2) == 11, "2017-07-11",
                             substring(tostring(parsedProperties.patchLevel), 0, 2) == 12, "2019-07-09",
                             substring(tostring(parsedProperties.patchLevel), 0, 2) == 13, "2021-07-13",

                             substring(tostring(parsedProperties.patchLevel), 0, 2) == 15, "2025-01-07",
                             "2028-01-11"),
        ExtendedSupportEndDate = case( substring(tostring(parsedProperties.patchLevel), 0, 2) == 11, "2022-07-12",
                             substring(tostring(parsedProperties.patchLevel), 0, 2) == 12, "2024-07-09",
                             substring(tostring(parsedProperties.patchLevel), 0, 2) == 13, "2026-07-14",
                             substring(tostring(parsedProperties.patchLevel), 0, 2) == 14, "2027-10-12",

content.query:
resources
| where type == "microsoft.hybridcompute/machines" and properties['detectedProperties']['mssqldiscovered'] == "true" and ('*' in ({ResourceGroup}) or resourceGroup in ({ResourceGroup})) and tostring(tags['sqlmanaged']) != 'false'
| extend
    joinID = toupper(id), ConnectedMachineProxy=parse_json(properties.agentConfiguration.proxyUrl)
| join kind= leftouter  (
    resources
    | where type == "microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/extensions" and name == "WindowsAgent.SqlServer" and ('*' in ({ResourceGroup}) or resourceGroup in ({ResourceGroup}))
    | extend machineId = toupper(substring(id, 0, indexof(id, '/extensions'))), SQLExtensionStatus = parse_json(properties).provisioningState, esuLastUpdate = todatetime(parse_json(properties).settings.esuLastUpdatedTimestamp), LicenseType=parse_json(properties.settings.LicenseType), Version = tostring(properties.typeHandlerVersion)
    | project machineId, name, SQLExtensionStatus, esuLastUpdate, LicenseType, Version
) on $left.joinID == $right.machineId
| join kind= leftouter  (
    resources
    | where type == "microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/extensions" and name == "AzureMonitorWindowsAgent" and ('*' in ({ResourceGroup}) or resourceGroup in ({ResourceGroup}))
    | extend machineId = toupper(substring(id, 0, indexof(id, '/extensions'))), MonitoringAgentStatus = parse_json(properties).provisioningState, MonitoringAgentProxy=parse_json(properties.settings.proxy.address)
    | project machineId, name, MonitoringAgentStatus, MonitoringAgentProxy
) on $left.joinID == $right.machineId
| project id, Connected = tostring(properties.status), LicenseType
, SQLExtensionStatus = iif(isnull(SQLExtensionStatus), "Missing", tostring(SQLExtensionStatus)), Version
, MonitoringAgentStatus = iif(isnull(MonitoringAgentStatus), "Missing", tostring(MonitoringAgentStatus))
, ProxyConsistencyCheck = iff(iif(isempty(tostring(MonitoringAgentProxy)), "No", tostring(MonitoringAgentProxy)) == iif(isempty(tostring(ConnectedMachineProxy)), "No", tostring(ConnectedMachineProxy)), true, false), esuLastUpdate, resourceGroup = strcat('/subscriptions/', subscriptionId, '/resourceGroups/',resourceGroup), subscriptionId = strcat('/subscriptions/', subscriptionId)
| extend ErrorsCheck = iff(Connected=="Connected", 0,1) + iif(tostring(LicenseType)=="Paid",0,1) + iif(tostring(SQLExtensionStatus)=="Succeeded",0,1) + iif(tostring(MonitoringAgentStatus)=="Succeeded",0,1) + iif(ProxyConsistencyCheck==true,0,1)
| where ErrorsCheck >= {ErrorsCheck}
| order by id asc

content.json:
---
## CPU Utilization
Select a machine row above or in the grid below to view its CPU trend. Requires AMA collecting performance counters to Log Analytics.

parameters.name: CpuWorkspace
parameters.label: Log Analytics Workspace
parameters.description: Workspace(s) receiving CPU performance data from AMA
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces'
| project value = id, label = name, group = subscriptionId

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true
    (InsightsMetrics
    | where Namespace == "Processor" and Name == "UtilizationPercentage"
    | where TimeGenerated > ago({CpuTimeRange})
    | project TimeGenerated, Val, _ResourceId),
    (Perf
    | where ObjectName == "Processor" and CounterName == "% Processor Time" and InstanceName == "_Total"
    | where TimeGenerated > ago({CpuTimeRange})
    | project TimeGenerated, Val = CounterValue, _ResourceId)
| extend Computer = tostring(split(_ResourceId, "/")[-1])
| summarize AvgCPU = round(avg(Val), 1), PeakCPU = round(max(Val), 1), P95CPU = round(percentile(Val, 95), 1) by _ResourceId, Computer
| order by PeakCPU desc
content.title: CPU Utilization Summary (click a row for details)
content.noDataMessage: No CPU data found. Ensure AMA is collecting performance counters to the selected workspace.

content.query:
let grain = case('{CpuTimeRange}' == '1h', time(1m), '{CpuTimeRange}' == '24h', time(5m), '{CpuTimeRange}' == '7d', time(30m), time(2h));
union isfuzzy=true
    (InsightsMetrics
    | where Namespace == "Processor" and Name == "UtilizationPercentage"
    | where TimeGenerated > ago({CpuTimeRange})
    | where _ResourceId =~ "{SelectedMachine}"
    | project TimeGenerated, Val, _ResourceId),
    (Perf
    | where ObjectName == "Processor" and CounterName == "% Processor Time" and InstanceName == "_Total"
    | where TimeGenerated > ago({CpuTimeRange})
    | where _ResourceId =~ "{SelectedMachine}"
    | project TimeGenerated, Val = CounterValue, _ResourceId)
| summarize AvgCPU = round(avg(Val), 1), PeakCPU = round(max(Val), 1) by bin(TimeGenerated, grain)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: CPU Trend — {SelectedMachine}
content.noDataMessage: No CPU data for the selected machine in the chosen time range.

parameters.description: Choose all Log Analytics Workspace to analyze BPA result in one place
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces'
| project WorkspaceId = id, WorkspaceName = name, subscriptionId
| join kind = inner (
    resourcecontainers
    | where type == "microsoft.resources/subscriptions"
    | project subscriptionId, subscriptionName = name
) on $left.subscriptionId == $right.subscriptionId
| join kind = inner (
    resourcecontainers
    | where type == "microsoft.resources/subscriptions/resourcegroups"

content.query:
SqlAssessment_CL
| extend asmt = parse_csv(RawData), resourceGroup = tostring(split(_ResourceId, "/", 4)[0])
| where ('*' in ({ResourceGroup}) or resourceGroup in ({ResourceGroup}))
| distinct _ResourceId=toupper(_ResourceId), InstanceName=tostring(asmt[11]), AsmtTime = todatetime(asmt[0]), AsmtId=tostring(asmt[1])
, BPAlink = 
        iff(toupper(asmt[11]) == 'MSSQLSERVER',
        strcat(toupper(replace_string(toupper(_ResourceId), 'HYBRIDCOMPUTE/MACHINES', 'AzureArcData/SqlServerInstances'))),
        strcat(toupper(replace_string(toupper(_ResourceId), 'HYBRIDCOMPUTE/MACHINES', 'AzureArcData/SqlServerInstances')), '_', toupper(asmt[11])))
| where isnotempty(AsmtId)
| summarize AsmtTime = strcat(format_datetime(max(AsmtTime), 'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm tt'), ' UTC'), count() by _ResourceId, InstanceName, AsmtId, BPAlink
| summarize LastRunTime = arg_max(AsmtTime, AsmtId), TotalRuns = count() by _ResourceId, InstanceName, BPAlink
| sort by _ResourceId asc, InstanceName asc

content.query:
SqlAssessment_CL
| extend asmt = parse_csv(RawData), resourceGroup = tostring(split(_ResourceId, "/", 4)[0])
| where ('*' in ({ResourceGroup}) or resourceGroup in ({ResourceGroup}))
| extend
    AsmtId=tostring(asmt[1]),
    CheckId=tostring(asmt[2]),
    DisplayString=asmt[3],
    Description=tostring(asmt[4]),
    HelpLink=asmt[5],
    TargetType=case(asmt[6] == 1, "Server", asmt[6] == 2, "Database", ""),
    TargetName=tostring(asmt[7]), 
    Severity=case(asmt[8] == 30, "High", asmt[8] == 20, "Medium", asmt[8] == 10, "Low", asmt[8] == 0, "Information", asmt[8] == 1, "Warning", asmt[8] == 2, "Critical", "Passed"),
    Message=tostring(asmt[9]),
    TagsArr=split(tostring(asmt[10]), ","),
    Sev = toint(asmt[8])
    | where isnotempty(AsmtId)
    | order by CheckId, _ResourceId
    | join kind=inner
    (
    SqlAssessment_CL
    | extend asmt = parse_csv(RawData)
    | extend
        AsmtId=tostring(asmt[1])
        | where isnotempty(AsmtId)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by _ResourceId
    | project AsmtId
    ) on AsmtId
    |where Sev >= 0
    | summarize count() by Severity, Sev
    | order by Sev

content.title: Issues by severity

parameters.name: filterTags
parameters.label: Tags
parameters.query:
let SeverityFilter = dynamic([{severity}]);
SqlAssessment_CL
| extend asmt = parse_csv(RawData), resourceGroup = tostring(split(_ResourceId, "/", 4)[0])
| where ('*' in ({ResourceGroup}) or resourceGroup in ({ResourceGroup}))
| extend AsmtId=tostring(asmt[1]), 
TagsArr=split(tostring(asmt[10]), ","), Sev = toint(asmt[8]), TargetType=toint(asmt[6]), TargetName=tostring(asmt[7]), Message=tostring(asmt[9]), CheckId=tostring(asmt[2]), Severity=case(asmt[8] == 30, "High", asmt[8] == 20, "Medium", asmt[8] == 10, "Low", asmt[8] == 0, "Information", asmt[8] == 1, "Warning", asmt[8] == 2, "Critical", "Passed")
| where Sev >= 0 and Severity in (SeverityFilter)
| join kind=inner
    (
    SqlAssessment_CL
    | extend asmt = parse_csv(RawData)
    | extend
        AsmtId=tostring(asmt[1])
        | where isnotempty(AsmtId)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by _ResourceId
    | project AsmtId
    ) on AsmtId
| mv-expand TagsArr
| where TagsArr != 'DefaultRuleset'
| project Tag = tostring(TagsArr), TargetType, TargetName, Message, Sev, CheckId
| distinct * 
| summarize Cnt = count() by Tag
| order by Cnt desc
| project value = Tag, label = strcat(Tag, ' (', Cnt, ')')

content.json:
# Storage & I/O Analysis
Disk configuration, live I/O performance metrics, and storage best practice recommendations for SQL Server VMs.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks'
| where ('*' in ({ResourceGroup}) or resourceGroup in ({ResourceGroup}))
| extend diskSku = tostring(sku.name)
| extend diskSizeGB = toint(properties.diskSizeGB)
| extend osType = tostring(properties.osType)
| project diskId = tolower(id), diskName = name, diskSku, diskSizeGB, osType, diskRG = resourceGroup
| join kind=inner (
    resources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'
    | where ('*' in ({ResourceGroup}) or resourceGroup in ({ResourceGroup}))
    | extend vmSize = tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize)
    | extend osDiskId = tolower(tostring(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.managedDisk.id))
    | extend osDiskCaching = tostring(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.caching)
    | extend dataDisks = properties.storageProfile.dataDisks
    | extend dataDiskCount = array_length(dataDisks)
    | mv-expand disk = dataDisks
    | extend dataDiskId = tolower(tostring(disk.managedDisk.id))
    | extend dataDiskCaching = tostring(disk.caching)
    | extend diskLun = toint(disk.lun)
    | project vmName = name, vmSize, osDiskId, osDiskCaching, dataDiskCount, diskLun, dataDiskId, dataDiskCaching, vmRG = resourceGroup
) on $left.diskId == $right.dataDiskId
| join kind=leftouter (
    resources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks'
    | project osDiskLookup = tolower(id), osDiskSku = tostring(sku.name), osDiskSizeGB = toint(properties.diskSizeGB)
) on $left.osDiskId == $right.osDiskLookup
| project vmName, vmSize, osDiskSku, osDiskSizeGB, osDiskCaching, dataDiskCount, diskLun, dataDiskSku = diskSku, dataDiskSizeGB = diskSizeGB, dataDiskCaching
| order by vmName asc, diskLun asc

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'
| where ('*' in ({ResourceGroup}) or resourceGroup in ({ResourceGroup}))
| extend osDiskId = tolower(tostring(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.managedDisk.id))
| extend osDiskCaching = tostring(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.caching)
| extend dataDisks = properties.storageProfile.dataDisks
| extend dataDiskCount = array_length(dataDisks)
| mv-expand disk = dataDisks
| extend dataDiskId = tolower(tostring(disk.managedDisk.id))
| extend diskCaching = tostring(disk.caching)
| join kind=leftouter (
    resources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks'
    | project osDiskLookup = tolower(id), osDiskSku = tostring(sku.name)
) on $left.osDiskId == $right.osDiskLookup
| join kind=leftouter (
    resources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks'
    | project dataDiskLookup = tolower(id), diskSku = tostring(sku.name)
) on $left.dataDiskId == $right.dataDiskLookup
| summarize 
    DataDisks = max(dataDiskCount),
    PremiumDisks = countif(diskSku contains 'Premium'),
    ReadOnlyDisks = countif(diskCaching == 'ReadOnly'),
    NoCacheDisks = countif(diskCaching == 'None')
    by name, osDiskSku, osDiskCaching
| extend 
    OsDiskCheck = case(osDiskSku contains 'Premium', strcat('Pass: ', osDiskSku), osDiskSku contains 'StandardSSD', strcat('OK: ', osDiskSku), strcat('Fail: ', osDiskSku)),
    DataDiskTierCheck = iff(PremiumDisks == DataDisks, strcat('Pass: All Premium (', DataDisks, ')'), iff(PremiumDisks > 0, strcat('Partial: ', PremiumDisks, '/', DataDisks, ' Premium'), strcat('Fail: No Premium (', DataDisks, ' disks)'))),
    CachingCheck = iff(ReadOnlyDisks > 0, strcat('Pass: ', ReadOnlyDisks, '/', DataDisks, ' ReadOnly'), 'Fail: No ReadOnly caching'),
    MultiDiskCheck = iff(DataDisks > 1, strcat('Pass: ', DataDisks, ' disks (striping possible)'), strcat('Review: Only ', DataDisks, ' disk'))
| project name, OsDiskCheck, DataDiskTierCheck, CachingCheck, MultiDiskCheck, DataDisks
| order by name asc

| extend TotalIOPS = AvgReadIOPS + AvgWriteIOPS

content.query:
SqlAssessment_CL
| extend asmt = parse_csv(RawData), resourceGroup = tostring(split(_ResourceId, "/", 4)[0])
| where ('*' in ({ResourceGroup}) or resourceGroup in ({ResourceGroup}))
| extend
    AsmtId = tostring(asmt[1]),
    CheckId = tostring(asmt[2]),
    DisplayString = tostring(asmt[3]),
    Description = tostring(asmt[4]),
    HelpLink = tostring(asmt[5]),
    TargetType = case(asmt[6] == 1, "Server", asmt[6] == 2, "Database", ""),
    TargetName = tostring(asmt[7]),
    Severity = case(asmt[8] == 30, "High", asmt[8] == 20, "Medium", asmt[8] == 10, "Low", asmt[8] == 0, "Information", "Passed"),
    Message = tostring(asmt[9]),
    Tags = tostring(asmt[10]),
    Sev = toint(asmt[8])
| where isnotempty(AsmtId)
| join kind=inner (
    SqlAssessment_CL
    | extend asmt = parse_csv(RawData)
    | extend AsmtId = tostring(asmt[1])
    | where isnotempty(AsmtId)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by _ResourceId
    | project AsmtId
) on AsmtId
| where Sev >= 0
| where Message has_any ('disk', 'storage', 'tempdb', 'file', 'volume', 'drive', 'I/O', 'IOPS', 'latency', 'throughput', 'data file', 'log file', 'filegroup', 'autogrow', 'initial size', 'instant file', 'trace flag 1117', 'trace flag 1118')
    or Tags has_any ('IO', 'Storage', 'DiskConfiguration', 'TempDb')
    or CheckId has_any ('TempDbFileCount', 'TempDbDataFileSize', 'TF1117', 'TF1118', 'DataLogSameVolume', 'TempDbOnOsDrive')
| project Computer = tostring(split(_ResourceId, "/")[-1]), Severity, Sev, TargetType, TargetName, CheckId, Message, HelpLink
| distinct *
| order by Sev desc, Computer asc

content.json:
---
## Azure SQL VM Storage Best Practices

| Recommendation | Why | Impact |
|---|---|---|
| **Separate data, log, and tempdb onto different disks** | Prevents I/O contention between read-heavy data, sequential log writes, and tempdb | High |
| **Use Premium SSD or Ultra Disk for production** | Guaranteed IOPS/throughput with low latency (<1ms for Ultra) | High |
| **Enable ReadOnly caching on data disks** | Serves repeated reads from host cache, reducing disk I/O | High |
| **No caching on transaction log disks** | Log writes are sequential and don't benefit from caching | Medium |
| **Use disk striping (Storage Spaces) for IOPS aggregation** | Combines IOPS/throughput of multiple disks | High |
| **Set 64KB NTFS allocation unit size** | Matches SQL Server extent size for optimal I/O alignment | Medium |
| **Enable instant file initialization** | Eliminates zero-fill on data file growth, reducing wait times | Medium |
| **Right-size VM for expected IOPS** | VM size caps max cached/uncached IOPS regardless of disk config | High |
| **Monitor disk queue length** | Queue >2 per disk sustained indicates I/O bottleneck | Medium |
| **Disk latency <10ms for OLTP workloads** | Higher latency degrades query performance | High |

> **Reference:** [Azure SQL VM Storage Configuration Best Practices](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-sql/virtual-machines/windows/performance-guidelines-best-practices-storage)
